我的生活与健康生活(My Life and a healthy life): 一篇关于健康生活的A2短文:马克斯与汤姆的经历和小计划。
There are always many people at the swimming pool. Max wrote about the day in the diary. Tom is interested in reading. The play went horribly wrong when the lights failed.
Both of them like chicken and juice. Max thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Max borrowed a book about history from the museum. In fact, fresh air fixed the headache.
Max learned a lot about history. Max wants to be a driver in the future. Last Sunday, Max and Tom went to the gym. Best of all, shift work scrambles the body clock.
The weather was rainy that day. Max usually has chicken for breakfast. It takes twenty minutes to get to the gym by bike.
